/-! Actual signed prime sums, Euler products, and Mobius observables.
Definitions only. An unordered zero sum is useful only with an explicit
summability guard supplied by a node claim; no simple-zero convention is used.
All finite sums use ordinary inclusive natural-floor endpoints. -/
namespace IEANTN.SignedArithmetic
open Finset ArithmeticFunction
noncomputable def primes (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime
noncomputable def A (x : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ p ∈ primes x, Real.log p / p
noncomputable def CA (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) / n
noncomputable def q (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if n.Prime then Real.log n / ((n : ℝ) * (n - 1 : ℝ)) else 0
noncomputable def correctionConstant : ℝ := ∑' n : ℕ, q n
noncomputable def E : ℝ := - Real.eulerMascheroniConstant - correctionConstant

def PaperZero := {s : ℂ // 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1 ∧ s.im ≠ 0 ∧ riemannZeta s = 0}
/-- Actual order of vanishing; counted with multiplicity, rather than enumerating distinct
zeros as if all were simple. This is Mathlib's meromorphic order, converted to Nat. -/
noncomputable def zeroMultiplicity (s : PaperZero) : ℕ :=
  ((meromorphicOrderAt riemannZeta s.val).untopD 0).toNat
noncomputable def reciprocalWeight (s : PaperZero) : ℝ :=
  (zeroMultiplicity s : ℝ) / s.val.im^2
noncomputable def reciprocalMass : ℝ := ∑' s : PaperZero, reciprocalWeight s
/-- BFKNW (29), specialized to m=1, on the actual zero domain and multiplicities. -/
noncomputable def J1 (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' s : PaperZero, (zeroMultiplicity s : ℝ) * x^(s.val.re-1) / s.val.im^2

noncomputable def beta : ℝ :=
  2+Real.eulerMascheroniConstant-Real.log Real.pi-2*Real.log 2

noncomputable def product (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∏ p ∈ primes x, (1-1/(p:ℝ))⁻¹

/-- The actual source's f, Eq(1.9). -/
noncomputable def f (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * Real.log (Chebyshev.theta x) *
    ∏ p ∈ primes x, (1-1/(p:ℝ))

/-- All nontrivial zeros, with the source's multiplicity convention. -/
def ProductZero := {s : ℂ // 0<s.re ∧ s.re<1 ∧ riemannZeta s=0}
noncomputable def multiplicity (s : ProductZero) : ℕ :=
  ((meromorphicOrderAt riemannZeta s.val).untopD 0).toNat
/-- Nicolas Eq(1.18), ordinary positive real x and conjugate-paired real part. -/
noncomputable def spectralTerm (x : ℝ) (s : ProductZero) : ℂ :=
  (multiplicity s:ℂ) * (x:ℂ)^(Complex.I*(s.val.im:ℂ)) / (s.val*(1-s.val))
noncomputable def W (x : ℝ) : ℝ := (∑' s : ProductZero,spectralTerm x s).re

  2-beta-(2+beta)/Real.log x-4*beta/(Real.log x)^2-
    Real.sqrt x*Real.log x/(2*(x-1))


noncomputable def mobiusM (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℝ)
noncomputable def mobiusm (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℝ) / n
end IEANTN.SignedArithmetic

  ∀ x : ℝ, 3 ≤ x → |primitive x| ≤ primitiveEnvelope x

  ∑' k : ℕ, primeCounting (x^(1/(k+2:ℝ)))/(k+2:ℝ)

Only definitions. Zero packets include actual zeta multiplicity. Analytic input
nodes require summability; no totalized sum is treated as proof evidence. -/
namespace IEANTN.RHSmoothing
open Real MeasureTheory Set
noncomputable def parabola (u : ℝ) : ℝ := (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (1 - u ^ 2)
noncomputable def box (_u : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 / 2
noncomputable def v (L : ℝ) : ℝ := L / 2 - Real.log L
noncomputable def delta (L : ℝ) : ℝ := L / (2 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt (Real.exp L))
noncomputable def average (k : ℝ → ℝ) (s L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ u in (-1 : ℝ)..1, k u * Chebyshev.psi
    (Real.exp L * Real.exp ((s + u) * delta L))
noncomputable def mainAverage (k : ℝ → ℝ) (s L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ u in (-1 : ℝ)..1, k u *
    (Real.exp L * Real.exp ((s + u) * delta L))
noncomputable def trivial (t : ℝ) : ℝ := -(Real.log (1 - t ^ (-2 : ℤ))) / 2
noncomputable def trivialAverage (k : ℝ → ℝ) (s L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ u in (-1 : ℝ)..1, k u * trivial
    (Real.exp L * Real.exp ((s + u) * delta L))
noncomputable def fourier (k : ℝ → ℝ) (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ u in (-1 : ℝ)..1, k u * Real.cos (y * u)
noncomputable def J (k : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
    (|fourier k y| - if y ≤ 1 then 1 else 0) * (Real.log y) ^ j / y
abbrev Zero := IEANTN.zetaZeroesIn (Set.Ioo 0 1) Set.univ
noncomputable def zeroPacket (k : ℝ → ℝ) (s L : ℝ) (ρ : Zero) : ℂ :=
  (Real.exp L : ℂ) ^ (ρ : ℂ) / (ρ : ℂ) *
    (∫ u in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (k u : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp ((ρ : ℂ) * (((s + u) * delta L : ℝ) : ℂ))) *
    (IEANTN.zetaOrder ρ : ℂ)
noncomputable def zeroAverage (k : ℝ → ℝ) (s L : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' ρ : Zero, zeroPacket k s L ρ
noncomputable def envelope (j0 j1 L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (v L ^ 2 + 2 * j0 * v L + 2 * j1 + L) / (2 * Real.pi) + 14 / 100


noncomputable def fastBound (L : ℝ) : ℝ := envelope (Real.log 2) (567 / 800) L
noncomputable def chBound (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let u := L / 2 - Real.log L + Real.log (10 / Real.pi)
  (158 / 1000) * L + (u ^ 2 - u / 3) / (2 * Real.pi) + 181 / 1000
end IEANTN.RHSmoothing

import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.DerivHyp
namespace IEANTN.PrimeWindows
open Real MeasureTheory Set Finset
noncomputable def primeCounting (x : ℝ) : ℝ := Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊
noncomputable def primesBetween (a b : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Nat.primesLE ⌊b⌋₊).filter fun p => a < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) < b
noncomputable def kernel (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ := max 0 (1 - u ^ (2 * n))
noncomputable def mass (n : ℕ) : ℝ := 4 * (n : ℝ) / (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1)
noncomputable def D (C L : ℝ) : ℝ := C / 2 * L - 1
noncomputable def δ (C L : ℝ) : ℝ := D C L * Real.exp (-L / 2)
noncomputable def a (C L : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp (L - δ C L)
noncomputable def b (C L : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp (L + δ C L)
noncomputable def population (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ p ∈ primesBetween (a C L) (b C L),
    kernel n ((Real.log p - L) / δ C L) * (Real.log p / Real.sqrt p)
noncomputable def mangoldtPopulation (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (⌊b C L⌋₊ + 1)).filter
      (fun k : ℕ => a C L < (k : ℝ) ∧ (k : ℝ) < b C L),
    kernel n ((Real.log (k : ℝ) - L) / δ C L) *
      ((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (k : ℝ))
noncomputable def transform (n : ℕ) (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ u in (-1 : ℝ)..1, kernel n u * Real.cos (y * u)
noncomputable def zeroPacket (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) (ρ : IEANTN.RHSmoothing.Zero) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((ρ : ℂ).im * L : ℝ)) *
    (δ C L * transform n (δ C L * (ρ : ℂ).im) : ℝ) *
    (IEANTN.zetaOrder ρ : ℂ)
noncomputable def zeroTerm (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' ρ : IEANTN.RHSmoothing.Zero, zeroPacket n C L ρ
noncomputable def mainTerm (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  D C L * ∫ u in (-1 : ℝ)..1, kernel n u * Real.cosh (δ C L * u / 2)
noncomputable def trivialCost (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in a C L..b C L, kernel n ((Real.log t - L) / δ C L) /
    (Real.sqrt t * t * (t ^ 2 - 1))
noncomputable def countCoefficient (n : ℕ) (A C : ℝ) : ℝ := mass n * C / 2 - A / 2

def ExplicitFormula (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) : Prop := RiemannHypothesis →
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → Summable (zeroPacket n C L) ∧
    mangoldtPopulation n C L = mainTerm n C L - (zeroTerm n C L).re - trivialCost n C L

def ZeroEstimate (n : ℕ) (C A B R : ℝ) : Prop := RiemannHypothesis →
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → ‖zeroTerm n C L‖ ≤
    A * (L / 2 - Real.log (2 * Real.pi * D C L)) + B + R

def PrimePowerCost (n : ℕ) (C P : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → mangoldtPopulation n C L - population n C L ≤ P

def TrivialCost (n : ℕ) (C T : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → trivialCost n C L ≤ T

/-- Exact scalar geometry and logarithmic margin; contains no prime-count goal. -/
def ScalarGeometry (n : ℕ) (C A B R P T η : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → 0 < a C L ∧ 2 ≤ Real.log (a C L) ∧
    a C L ≤ b C L ∧ L - δ C L = Real.log (a C L) ∧ 0 ≤ δ C L ∧
    0 ≤ D C L ∧ 0 ≤ countCoefficient n A C ∧ 0 < η ∧
    η < A * Real.log (2 * Real.pi * D C L) - mass n - B - R - P - T

def ForwardCoverage (C : ℝ) : Prop := ∀ u : ℝ, Real.exp 24 ≤ u →
  ∃ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L ∧ a C L = u ∧
    b C L ≤ u + C * Real.sqrt u * Real.log u


end IEANTN.PrimeWindows

namespace IEANTN.PrimeWindows
open Real MeasureTheory Set Finset
noncomputable def primeCounting (x : ℝ) : ℝ := Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊
noncomputable def primesBetween (a b : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Nat.primesLE ⌊b⌋₊).filter fun p => a < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) < b
noncomputable def kernel (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ := max 0 (1 - u ^ (2 * n))
noncomputable def mass (n : ℕ) : ℝ := 4 * (n : ℝ) / (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1)
noncomputable def D (C L : ℝ) : ℝ := C / 2 * L - 1
noncomputable def δ (C L : ℝ) : ℝ := D C L * Real.exp (-L / 2)
noncomputable def a (C L : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp (L - δ C L)
noncomputable def b (C L : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp (L + δ C L)
noncomputable def population (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ p ∈ primesBetween (a C L) (b C L),
    kernel n ((Real.log p - L) / δ C L) * (Real.log p / Real.sqrt p)
noncomputable def mangoldtPopulation (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (⌊b C L⌋₊ + 1)).filter
      (fun k : ℕ => a C L < (k : ℝ) ∧ (k : ℝ) < b C L),
    kernel n ((Real.log (k : ℝ) - L) / δ C L) *
      ((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (k : ℝ))
noncomputable def transform (n : ℕ) (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ u in (-1 : ℝ)..1, kernel n u * Real.cos (y * u)
noncomputable def zeroPacket (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) (ρ : IEANTN.RHSmoothing.Zero) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((ρ : ℂ).im * L : ℝ)) *
    (δ C L * transform n (δ C L * (ρ : ℂ).im) : ℝ) *
    (IEANTN.zetaOrder ρ : ℂ)
noncomputable def zeroTerm (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' ρ : IEANTN.RHSmoothing.Zero, zeroPacket n C L ρ
noncomputable def mainTerm (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  D C L * ∫ u in (-1 : ℝ)..1, kernel n u * Real.cosh (δ C L * u / 2)
noncomputable def trivialCost (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in a C L..b C L, kernel n ((Real.log t - L) / δ C L) /
    (Real.sqrt t * t * (t ^ 2 - 1))
noncomputable def countCoefficient (n : ℕ) (A C : ℝ) : ℝ := mass n * C / 2 - A / 2

def ExplicitFormula (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) : Prop := RiemannHypothesis →
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → Summable (zeroPacket n C L) ∧
    mangoldtPopulation n C L = mainTerm n C L - (zeroTerm n C L).re - trivialCost n C L

def ZeroEstimate (n : ℕ) (C A B R : ℝ) : Prop := RiemannHypothesis →
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → ‖zeroTerm n C L‖ ≤
    A * (L / 2 - Real.log (2 * Real.pi * D C L)) + B + R

def PrimePowerCost (n : ℕ) (C P : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → mangoldtPopulation n C L - population n C L ≤ P

def TrivialCost (n : ℕ) (C T : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → trivialCost n C L ≤ T

  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → 0 < a C L ∧ 2 ≤ Real.log (a C L) ∧

    0 ≤ D C L ∧ 0 ≤ countCoefficient n A C ∧ 0 < η ∧
    η < A * Real.log (2 * Real.pi * D C L) - mass n - B - R - P - T

def ForwardCoverage (C : ℝ) : Prop := ∀ u : ℝ, Real.exp 24 ≤ u →
  ∃ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L ∧ a C L = u ∧
    b C L ≤ u + C * Real.sqrt u * Real.log u


end IEANTN.PrimeWindows

namespace IEANTN.SignedArithmetic
open Finset ArithmeticFunction

  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) / n
noncomputable def q (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if n.Prime then Real.log n / ((n : ℝ) * (n - 1 : ℝ)) else 0
noncomputable def correctionConstant : ℝ := ∑' n : ℕ, q n
noncomputable def E : ℝ := - Real.eulerMascheroniConstant - correctionConstant

def PaperZero := {s : ℂ // 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1 ∧ s.im ≠ 0 ∧ riemannZeta s = 0}
/-- Actual order of vanishing; counted with multiplicity, rather than enumerating distinct
zeros as if all were simple. This is Mathlib's meromorphic order, converted to Nat. -/
noncomputable def zeroMultiplicity (s : PaperZero) : ℕ :=
  ((meromorphicOrderAt riemannZeta s.val).untopD 0).toNat

  (zeroMultiplicity s : ℝ) / s.val.im^2
noncomputable def reciprocalMass : ℝ := ∑' s : PaperZero, reciprocalWeight s

  ∑' s : PaperZero, (zeroMultiplicity s : ℝ) * x^(s.val.re-1) / s.val.im^2

noncomputable def beta : ℝ :=
  2+Real.eulerMascheroniConstant-Real.log Real.pi-2*Real.log 2

noncomputable def product (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∏ p ∈ primes x, (1-1/(p:ℝ))⁻¹

/-- The actual source's f, Eq(1.9). -/
noncomputable def f (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * Real.log (Chebyshev.theta x) *
    ∏ p ∈ primes x, (1-1/(p:ℝ))

/-- All nontrivial zeros, with the source's multiplicity convention. -/
def ProductZero := {s : ℂ // 0<s.re ∧ s.re<1 ∧ riemannZeta s=0}
noncomputable def multiplicity (s : ProductZero) : ℕ :=
  ((meromorphicOrderAt riemannZeta s.val).untopD 0).toNat

noncomputable def spectralTerm (x : ℝ) (s : ProductZero) : ℂ :=

  2-beta-(2+beta)/Real.log x-4*beta/(Real.log x)^2-
    Real.sqrt x*Real.log x/(2*(x-1))

  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℝ)
noncomputable def mobiusm (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℝ) / n
end IEANTN.SignedArithmetic

noncomputable def zeroPacket (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) (ρ : IEANTN.RHSmoothing.Zero) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((ρ : ℂ).im * L : ℝ)) *
    (δ C L * transform n (δ C L * (ρ : ℂ).im) : ℝ) *
    (IEANTN.zetaOrder ρ : ℂ)
noncomputable def zeroTerm (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' ρ : IEANTN.RHSmoothing.Zero, zeroPacket n C L ρ
noncomputable def mainTerm (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  D C L * ∫ u in (-1 : ℝ)..1, kernel n u * Real.cosh (δ C L * u / 2)
noncomputable def trivialCost (n : ℕ) (C L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in a C L..b C L, kernel n ((Real.log t - L) / δ C L) /
    (Real.sqrt t * t * (t ^ 2 - 1))
noncomputable def countCoefficient (n : ℕ) (A C : ℝ) : ℝ := mass n * C / 2 - A / 2

def ExplicitFormula (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) : Prop := RiemannHypothesis →
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → Summable (zeroPacket n C L) ∧
    mangoldtPopulation n C L = mainTerm n C L - (zeroTerm n C L).re - trivialCost n C L

def ZeroEstimate (n : ℕ) (C A B R : ℝ) : Prop := RiemannHypothesis →
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → ‖zeroTerm n C L‖ ≤
    A * (L / 2 - Real.log (2 * Real.pi * D C L)) + B + R

def PrimePowerCost (n : ℕ) (C P : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → mangoldtPopulation n C L - population n C L ≤ P

def TrivialCost (n : ℕ) (C T : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → trivialCost n C L ≤ T

/-- Exact scalar geometry and logarithmic margin; contains no prime-count goal. -/
def ScalarGeometry (n : ℕ) (C A B R P T η : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L → 0 < a C L ∧ 2 ≤ Real.log (a C L) ∧
    a C L ≤ b C L ∧ L - δ C L = Real.log (a C L) ∧ 0 ≤ δ C L ∧
    0 ≤ D C L ∧ 0 ≤ countCoefficient n A C ∧ 0 < η ∧
    η < A * Real.log (2 * Real.pi * D C L) - mass n - B - R - P - T

def ForwardCoverage (C : ℝ) : Prop := ∀ u : ℝ, Real.exp 24 ≤ u →
  ∃ L : ℝ, 24 ≤ L ∧ a C L = u ∧
    b C L ≤ u + C * Real.sqrt u * Real.log u


end IEANTN.PrimeWindows

import Mathlib.NumberTheory.LSeries.RiemannZeta
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.ArithmeticFunction.Moebius
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.Chebyshev
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.Harmonic.EulerMascheroni
import Mathlib.Analysis.Meromorphic.Order

/-! Actual signed prime sums, Euler products, and Mobius observables.
Definitions only. An unordered zero sum is useful only with an explicit
summability guard supplied by a node claim; no simple-zero convention is used.
All finite sums use ordinary inclusive natural-floor endpoints. -/
namespace IEANTN.SignedArithmetic
open Finset ArithmeticFunction
noncomputable def primes (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime
noncomputable def A (x : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ p ∈ primes x, Real.log p / p
noncomputable def CA (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) / n
noncomputable def q (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if n.Prime then Real.log n / ((n : ℝ) * (n - 1 : ℝ)) else 0
noncomputable def correctionConstant : ℝ := ∑' n : ℕ, q n
noncomputable def E : ℝ := - Real.eulerMascheroniConstant - correctionConstant

def PaperZero := {s : ℂ // 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1 ∧ s.im ≠ 0 ∧ riemannZeta s = 0}
/-- Actual order of vanishing; counted with multiplicity, rather than enumerating distinct
zeros as if all were simple. This is Mathlib's meromorphic order, converted to Nat. -/
noncomputable def zeroMultiplicity (s : PaperZero) : ℕ :=
  ((meromorphicOrderAt riemannZeta s.val).untopD 0).toNat
noncomputable def reciprocalWeight (s : PaperZero) : ℝ :=
  (zeroMultiplicity s : ℝ) / s.val.im^2
noncomputable def reciprocalMass : ℝ := ∑' s : PaperZero, reciprocalWeight s
/-- BFKNW (29), specialized to m=1, on the actual zero domain and multiplicities. -/
noncomputable def J1 (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' s : PaperZero, (zeroMultiplicity s : ℝ) * x^(s.val.re-1) / s.val.im^2

noncomputable def beta : ℝ :=
  2+Real.eulerMascheroniConstant-Real.log Real.pi-2*Real.log 2

noncomputable def product (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∏ p ∈ primes x, (1-1/(p:ℝ))⁻¹

/-- The actual source's f, Eq(1.9). -/
noncomputable def f (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * Real.log (Chebyshev.theta x) *
    ∏ p ∈ primes x, (1-1/(p:ℝ))

/-- All nontrivial zeros, with the source's multiplicity convention. -/
def ProductZero := {s : ℂ // 0<s.re ∧ s.re<1 ∧ riemannZeta s=0}
noncomputable def multiplicity (s : ProductZero) : ℕ :=
  ((meromorphicOrderAt riemannZeta s.val).untopD 0).toNat
/-- Nicolas Eq(1.18), ordinary positive real x and conjugate-paired real part. -/
noncomputable def spectralTerm (x : ℝ) (s : ProductZero) : ℂ :=
  (multiplicity s:ℂ) * (x:ℂ)^(Complex.I*(s.val.im:ℂ)) / (s.val*(1-s.val))
noncomputable def W (x : ℝ) : ℝ := (∑' s : ProductZero,spectralTerm x s).re


noncomputable def profile (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2-beta-(2+beta)/Real.log x-4*beta/(Real.log x)^2-
    Real.sqrt x*Real.log x/(2*(x-1))


noncomputable def mobiusM (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℝ)
noncomputable def mobiusm (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℝ) / n
end IEANTN.SignedArithmetic
